message.content: I read Apple's FY2024 Form 10-K (fiscal year ended September 28, 2024), checked the live quote, and placed one buy order within your mandate. Apple's annual report shows total net sales of $391.0B (up 2% year over year), driven by Services growing 13% to $96.2B while iPhone held roughly flat; gross margin expanded to 46.2%, operating income rose to $123.2B, and operating cash flow was a robust $118.3B. Reported net income of $93.7B and diluted EPS of $6.08 were held back only by a one-time $10.2B net State Aid tax charge, so the underlying operating trends remain strong. With AAPL trading around $222.70, I bought 44 shares at a limit price of $222.75 for a total of about $9,801 — comfortably within the $10,000 per-order cap, buy-only, AAPL-only, with the limit set essentially at market. No money was moved out of the account, and no other orders were placed, leaving ample room under the $20,000 daily limit.
